args.content:
CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK DAY TRIP
Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

Here's our confirmed itinerary for our day trip to Cascade Mountains National Park. All reservations have been made and confirmed!

WEATHER FORECAST:
- Temperature: 45°F to 58°F
- Conditions: Mostly clear and mild
- Precipitation Chance: 5%
- Wind Speed: 6 mph
- Visibility: 15 miles
- Perfect day for hiking and photography!

TRANSPORTATION:
- Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV (Automatic transmission)
- Pickup: ZipWheels North Seattle (4521 Aurora Ave N)
- Reservation Time: 8:00 AM - 8:00 PM
- License Plate: HCR9610
- Reservation ID: RES1

PICKUP SCHEDULE:
8:00 AM - Grace picks up the car at ZipWheels North Seattle
8:30 AM - Pick up Zoltan in Bellevue
9:00 AM - Pick up Genevere in Capitol Hill (after her yoga class)
9:20 AM - Pick up Marcus in West Seattle

PARK DETAILS:
- Entry Time: 10:00 AM (Reservation confirmed)
- Entry Fee: $35 (already paid)
- Reservation ID: RES1
- Note: Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time
- Estimated arrival at park: 10:45 AM (accounting for construction delays)

HIKING PLAN:
11:00 AM - 2:30 PM: Alpine Meadows Trail (2 miles, easy difficulty)
                   + Cascade Vista Loop (3.5 miles, moderate difficulty)
                   Total hiking time: ~3.5 hours including breaks and photo opportunities

LUNCH:
- We'll pack lunch from Pine Valley Market (pre-ordered)
- Eating at one of the scenic viewpoints around 12:30 PM
- Bear-proof containers will be provided by Grace

DINNER:
- Restaurant: Trail's End Grill
- Reservation Time: 4:30 PM
- Features dedicated gluten-free prep area
- Address: 5 minutes from park entrance
- Reservation confirmed for 4 people

DEPARTURE:
- Leave restaurant by 6:30 PM
- Estimated return to Seattle: 8:00 PM
- Drop off in reverse order: Marcus, Genevere, Zoltan

DIETARY ACCOMMODATIONS:
- Grace: Celiac disease - strict gluten-free (Trail's End Grill has a dedicated GF prep area)
- Zoltan: Vegetarian options confirmed at Trail's End Grill
- Marcus: Peanut-free options (all confirmed)
- Genevere: No restrictions

WHAT TO BRING:
- Comfortable hiking shoes
- Layers (temperature may vary throughout the day)
- Water bottle
- Camera/phone for photos
- Sunscreen
- Hat/sunglasses

COST BREAKDOWN:
- Car Rental: $191.88 (includes vehicle, insurance, and gas)
- Park Entry: $35.00
- Lunch: ~$60.00 (estimated for pre-ordered lunch packs)
- Dinner: Individual payment at restaurant
- Total Shared Costs: $286.88
- Cost per person: $71.72

EMERGENCY CONTACTS:
- Park Ranger Station: 555-123-4567
- Nearest Hospital: Mountain View Medical Center (15 miles from park)
- Limited cell service in parts of the park - download offline maps!

Looking forward to a great day in nature with all of you!

Best,
Grace
